name: Kingdom of Prussia (1750–1801)
description: A white field with the black Prussian eagle, crowned, holding a sword and a sceptre and bearing the royal monogram 'FR' on its breast.
history: State flag of the Kingdom of Prussia in the version introduced in 1750 under Frederick the Great, with the eagle holding a sword in place of the orb. It was replaced in 1801 and again in 1803 by the flag with the eagle on a plain white field used until 1892.

features.role: crowned Prussian eagle with sword, sceptre and 'FR' monogram
